an8.8:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā uttaro mahisavatthusmiṃ viharati saṅkheyyake pabbate vaṭṭajālikāyaṃ.
an8.8:1.2: tatra kho āyasmā uttaro bhikkhū āmantesi
an8.8:1.3: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti
an8.8:1.4: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti
an8.8:1.5: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti
an8.8:1.6: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hotīti.
an8.8:2.1: tena kho pana samayena vessavaṇo mahārājā uttaradisāya dakkhiṇadisaṃ gacchati kenaci deva karaṇīyena
an8.8:2.2: assosi kho vessavaṇo mahārājā āyasmato uttarassa mahisavatthusmiṃ saṅkheyyake pabbate vaṭṭajālikāyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desentassa
an8.8:2.3: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti
an8.8:2.4: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti
an8.8:2.5: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti
an8.8:2.6: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hotīti
an8.8:3.1: athakho vessavaṇo mahārājā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva mahisavatthusmiṃ saṅkheyyake pabbate vaṭṭajālikāyaṃ antarahito devesu tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi
an8.8:3.2: athakho vessavaṇo mahārājā yena sakko devānamindo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca
an8.8:3.4: eso āyasmā uttaro mahisavatthusmiṃ saṅkheyyake pabbate vaṭṭajālikāyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti
an8.8:4.1: athakho sakko devānamindo seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva devesu tāvatiṃsesu antarahito mahisavatthusmiṃ saṅkheyyake pabbate vaṭṭajālikāyaṃ āyasmato uttarassa sammukhe pāturahosi
an8.8:4.2: athakho sakko devānamindo yenāyasmā uttaro tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyassamantaṃ uttaraṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho sakko devānamindo āyasmantaṃ uttaraṃ etadavoca
an8.8:5.1: saccaṃ kira bhante āyasmā uttaro bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desesi
an8.8:5.7: kiṃ pana bhante āyasmato uttarassa sakaṃ paṭibhāṇaṃ udāhu tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
an8.8:5.9: upamāyamidhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti
an8.8:6.1: seyyathāpi devānaminda gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahādhaññarāsi
an8.8:6.4: yo nu kho devānaminda mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ puccheyya
an8.8:6.5: kuto imaṃ dhaññaṃ āharathāti kathaṃ byākaramāno nu kho devānaminda so mahājanakāyo sammā byākaramāno byākareyyāti.
an8.8:6.6: amumhā mahādhaññarāsimhā āharāmāti kho bhante so mahājanakāyo sammā byākaramāno byākareyyāti.
an8.8:6.7: evameva kho devānaminda yaṃ kiñci subhāsitaṃ sabbantaṃ tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
an8.8:6.8: tato upādāyupādāya mayaṃ dhaññaṃ ca bhaṇāmāti.
an8.8:7.3: yaṃ kiñci subhāsitaṃ sabbantaṃ tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
an8.8:7.4: tato upādāyupādāya mayaṃ dhaññaṃ ca bhaṇāmāti
an8.8:7.5: evamidaṃ bhante uttara ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate acirapakkante devadatte
an8.8:7.6: tatra kho bhagavā devadattaṃ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi
an8.8:8.1: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti
an8.8:8.2: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ
an8.8:8.5: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho
an8.8:8.7: lābhena bhikkhave abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho
an8.8:8.14: pāpamittatāya bhikkhave abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho
an8.8:8.15: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho
an8.8:9.1: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya
an8.8:10.1: kiñca bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya
an8.8:11.1: yañhissa bhikkhave uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti
an8.8:11.8: uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti
an8.8:11.9: idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya
an8.8:13.1: ettāvatā bhante uttara manussesu catasso parisā
an8.8:13.4: uggaṇhātu bhante āyasmā uttaro imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ
an8.8:13.5: pariyāpuṇātu bhante āyasmā uttaro imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ
an8.8:13.6: dhāretu bhante āyasmā uttaro imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ
